verdict.rationale: Firebase's CLI does support import/export of Auth user data, but there is no documented open-format export path for Firestore/Realtime Database content, Security Rules, or other core data, and community comments explicitly call Firebase 'the poster child for vendor lock-in' and describe having to reimplement storage rules to leave the platform. This directly contradicts the story's claim of comprehensive open-format data portability. Missing for 10: documented full-data (Firestore/RTDB/Storage/Rules) export in open/standard formats, and any evidence refuting the lock-in complaints.
